description:
Location: Remote – Europe
Contract: Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior PostgreSQL DBA to manage and optimise mission-critical database infrastructure supporting high-volume iGaming operations.

You will take ownership of the performance, availability, security and scalability of PostgreSQL environments, primarily running on Amazon RDS and Aurora PostgreSQL.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimise large-scale PostgreSQL databases in a 24/7 production environment.

  • Monitor database performance, troubleshoot issues and optimise queries, indexes and partitioning.

  • Ensure high availability, security, backup, recovery and disaster recovery procedures.

  • Manage AWS RDS and Aurora PostgreSQL infrastructure, including networking and access controls.

  • Implement automation and infrastructure management using Python, Bash and Terraform.

  • Support integrations with Redis, Kafka and other messaging or caching technologies.

  • Maintain database reliability and compliance across critical iGaming systems, including player wallets, transactions, settlements and KYC data.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of DBA experience, with extensive hands-on PostgreSQL experience.

  • Strong production experience with AWS RDS PostgreSQL; Aurora PostgreSQL is highly desirable.

  • Mandatory iGaming experience, ideally supporting casino, sportsbook, poker, lottery or gaming payment systems.

  • Excellent knowledge of PostgreSQL internals, SQL, PL/pgSQL, performance tuning and database optimisation.

  • Experience managing multi-terabyte databases, high transaction volumes, partitioning and replication.

  • Strong AWS knowledge, including VPC, IAM, KMS and Secrets Manager.

  • Experience with backup, recovery, disaster recovery and high-availability strategies.

  • Proficiency in Python/Bash scripting and Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.

  • Excellent English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • AWS certifications.

  • Experience with Debezium, pglogical, Redshift, Snowflake or ClickHouse.

  • Knowledge of regulated iGaming markets and compliance requirements.

  • Experience with Aurora PostgreSQL Limitless or RDS Proxy.

Important: Candidates must be based in Europe. Remote working is available, but relocation is not offered.
